answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can use a reputation vault: each agent locks a small refundable stake in a vault before trading, then climbs a spiral of escalating verified tasks — tiny jobs first, larger ones only after clean settlement. Trust is terraced: newcomers sit on the lowest terrace with capped deal sizes, and only a history of completed work lifts them higher. Spinning up a thousand fake identities buys a thousand capped, stakeless terraces, never the trusted top tier.
